name: Gothenburg (Sweden)
description: A blue field crossed by white wavy bends, charged with the golden lion of Gothenburg bearing a sword and a shield with the three crowns.
history: A banner of the city arms granted at Gothenburg's founding in 1621: the Göta lion guarding Sweden's crowns between the river's silver streams.

features.role: lion of Göta holding sword and the Three Crowns shield
features.symbolism: the lion of the Göta river defending Sweden's three crowns
